bullets.text: Pornhub Uses Apple Verification - **Pornhub** adopts **Apple's** age verification feature for UK users to comply with new regulations.
AI Cuts Jobs at Cloudflare - **Cloudflare** reports 1,100 job cuts due to AI advancements, despite record revenue growth.
Google I/O 2026 Approaches - Anticipation builds for **Google I/O 2026**, with expected updates on **Gemini** and AI features.
New Apple TV Rumors - Upcoming **Apple TV 4K** may feature AI enhancements inspired by **Netflix's** latest functionalities.
Avride Under Investigation - **Avride**, an Uber partner, faces scrutiny over self-driving crashes amid safety concerns.
Porsche Shuts Subsidiaries - **Porsche** closes three subsidiaries to refocus on core business amid declining sales.
Intel and Apple Collaboration - **Apple** reportedly strikes a deal with **Intel** to use its chips again in future devices.
Yarbo Responds to Security Issues - **Yarbo** addresses vulnerabilities in its robot mower after a hacker incident.
Amazon's New Video Feature - **Amazon Prime Video** introduces a TikTok-like 'Clips' feed to enhance user engagement.
Poland's Water Security Threat - **Poland** reports cyberattacks on water treatment plants, highlighting global infrastructure vulnerabilities.
